rules.statement: The court has no power to add a party under section 18 of the Civil Procedure Code or section 16 of the Mortgage Act, No.6 of 1949.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am therefore of opinion that the Court has no power to add the 2nd respondent as a party under section 18 of the Civil Procedure Code."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 18 of the Civil Procedure Code or section 16 of the Mortgage Act, No.6 of 1949
